summary.zh: 登录后调用钉钉办公工具
summary.en: Call DingTalk office tools after sign-in

description.zh: 连接钉钉官方 MCP 服务，按组织授权后调用钉钉开放的办公工具。适合在对话里处理钉钉侧的日常办公事务。首次连接需在浏览器扫码登录钉钉账号。
description.en: Connect to DingTalk's hosted MCP service and call the office tools it exposes once your organization grants access. Useful for everyday DingTalk work from a conversation. Scan the QR code to sign in on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器扫码登录钉钉并授权
authHint.en: Scan the QR code to sign in to DingTalk on first connect
